description: Recommended role-based permissions profile and sandbox boundaries for AGY Security Audit under Default-Deny.

layer1_terminal_sandbox.boundary: OS-level process, network, and filesystem namespace jail
layer1_terminal_sandbox.objective: Prevent arbitrary shell execution, system compromise, or out-of-band egress via agy --sandbox

layer2_permission_engine.boundary: AGY runtime tool scheduling and authorization engine
layer2_permission_engine.objective: Enforce strict least-privilege tool capabilities per audit role

layer3_shadow_context_guard.objective: Prevent direct model exposure to unredacted secrets and enforce realpath containment algebra

layer4_deterministic_tcb.objective: Eliminate TOCTOU filesystem races and sibling path confusion via safe file descriptors

coordinator.description: Primary orchestrator (security-audit-coordinator) coordinating subagent swarms and deterministic scan finalization.

discovery.description: Discovery agent (discovery-agent) hunting candidate vulnerabilities in component x family matrices.

verifiers.description: Independent 3-lens verifiers (verifier-reachability, verifier-defenses, verifier-impact) voting on candidate validity.

remediation.description: Remediation agent operating inside isolated branch workspaces to draft patches for verified vulnerabilities.
